Prospect & the Sambro Loop

Legal services from Kostyantyn Mykhalchenko for clients in this region. Appointments in English, Ukrainian and Russian.

The local picture

These coastal and rural communities have a different travel context from the downtown peninsula. When arranging a legal appointment, confirm whether attendance is required and whether the task can be discussed remotely.

Prepare for the conversation

For land or inherited-property questions, collect the civic address, names on existing documents and any information about access before the conversation.

Arrange your appointment

The practice is based in Halifax and welcomes enquiries from throughout Nova Scotia. Include your community, the practice area and any deadlines. Availability and the scope of representation are confirmed after an initial conversation and conflict check.
